items.title: Small-parameter decay and uniform boundedness of the linearised operator symbol
items.author: Marnie Smith
items.work: Uniform semiclassical nonlinear Hartree phase mixing and weighted scattering for small perturbations
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 1092-1106, which has three parts: uniform decay of the linearised operator symbol in the large parameter, a uniform bound in the weighted Sobolev norm of the background, and a sharper bound with an extra factor of the parameter over the modulus of the spectral variable once the background lies in one more weighted space. The proof (source lines 1107-1131) first removes the zero frequency, then absorbs the sine factor by its argument to reduce the first two parts to a directional integral estimate, and finally integrates the integral representation of the symbol by parts in the radial variable, where it has to be checked that no boundary term survives and that the two resulting terms are controlled by the sharper norm. The statement records none of these reductions.
